releases.notes:
🔥 Big Update! Version 3.0.0 is Here! 🔥

Hey everyone! I’m excited to announce some awesome new features and improvements in the latest update! 🎉

✨What's New?✨

🕰️ Backpack Time Tracker Now you can see exactly how much time you’ve spent filling your current backpack! Keep track of your mining sessions with ease!

🏳️ Banner, Dragging, and Close Button Introducing a new banner that can be dragged around the screen. And yes, the trusty H keybind still works for toggling HUD visibility!

⚙️ Manual Rank Setter for Staff For all the staff members, since the rank fetcher doesn’t work for you, you can now set your rank manually with /rankset <rank,clear>!

🔒 Mod Visibility Limited to iBlocky Server The mod is now only visible when you’re connected to the iBlocky server. The HUD and features will automatically hide when you’re not on iBlocky.

💰 Sales Summary & Uncapped Balance You asked, and we delivered! A full sales summary feature is now included. Plus, we’ve removed the balance cap at 2'147'483'647. Now you can see your true wealth without overflow issues!

_____

🐛**Fixed Issues / Bugs / Small Improvements!**🐛

🖱️ Better Drag Handling Improved drag-and-drop functionality for smoother movement of the HUD window.

🔄 Booster Command Scheduler As a workaround for timer desync, a background scheduler now runs the /booster command automatically every 20 minutes to keep everything in sync!

Thanks for your continued feedback and support! Keep those suggestions coming, and as always, let me know if you run into any issues!

Cheers,
Holm ^-^

releases.notes:
🔥 **Holy Moly! An Update Already?!** 🔥

Hey everyone! I’ve got some exciting news to share with you all about the latest updates and improvements I’ve been working on!

---

✨**What's New?**✨
- **Major Code Optimization!**  ⚡
  I’ve refactored the code to make it more efficient, ensuring smoother performance and reducing any lag you might have experienced.

- **Lunar Client Support!**  🚀
  Good news for all the Lunar fans out there—it’s now fully compatible with Lunar Client!

- **New Hotkeys!**  ⌨️
  - Press `B` to quickly send the `/booster` command.
  - Press `H` to toggle the HUD on and off with ease.
  - Press `N` to toggle information on the HUD.
  - *(These key binds can be changed from the controls settings)*

- **Enhanced Sell Boost Calculation!**  📊
  The Sell Boost now also includes the rank booster in its calculations. The formula is now: `{RankBooster} + {TokenBooster} + {RichBooster}`.

- **Config File!**  🛠️
  A new config file has been added at `.Minecraft\config\iblocky_boosternoti.json`. You can now edit the HUD position and how often it fetches rank info!

---

🐛**Fixed Issues / Bugs!**🐛

- **HUD Scaling:** 📏 No more text dangling outside the box—the HUD now scales properly.
- **Added Days to Timer Format:** ⏰ Boosters are now displayed with days! Instead of showing `72h 0m 0s`, it now shows `3d 0h 0m 0s`.
- **Restrict GUI to Player's Screen:** 🖥️ The GUI is now constrained within the screen bounds, ensuring it stays visible.
- **HUD Position Saved:** 📌The HUD location is now stored in the config file, so it remembers your preferred position!
- **Fixed Dragging Issue:** 🖱️Previously, the window could stay attached to the mouse after exiting the chat. This is now fixed.
- **Removed "Active Booster":** ✂️This redundant label has been removed for a cleaner look.
- **Sell Boost Reset:**🔄 The "Sell Boost:" now resets correctly after the token booster timer runs out.
- **HUD Screen Bounds Check:** 🔍Ensures the HUD stays within the screen bounds, especially after a resolution change.

---

Thanks for all your feedback and support! Keep it coming, and let me know if you run into any issues or have more suggestions!

**Cheers,**  
**Holm ^-^**
